***[[Deportation of Eritreans from Sudan]]
****[[Eritrea]] is accused of the forced [[deportation]] and [[repatriation]] of 3,500 [[Eritreans]] from [[Sudan]] to [[Teseney]] and other towns near the Sudanese–Eritrean border. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Africa floods]]
**The death toll from the 6 May floods in the villages of Bushushu and Nyamukubi in [[South Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], increases to 401 people. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/5/7/dr-congo-floods-death-toll-surpasses-200 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2023 Tanur boat disaster]]
**At least 22 people are killed when a boat carrying [[tourism in Kerala|tourists]] [[capsize]]s in [[Tanur, Malappuram]], [[Kerala]], [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-65522435 (BBC News)]
*At least 12 people are killed and 31 others are injured in a multi-automobile crash in [[Hatay Province]], [[Turkey]]. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-fatal-traffic-crash-hatay-province-97a1acb10e50fa5b7367e283ebbe1d69 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Chile–Venezuela relations]], [[Venezuelan migrant crisis]], [[Chile–Peru relations]]
**[[government of Chile|Chile]] announces that 115 [[Venezuelans|Venezuelan]] migrants were repatriated to [[Venezuela]] on a [[humanitarian]] flight, after being stranded [[Chile–Peru border|at the border]] with [[Peru]], raising tensions between Peru and Chile. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/migrants-stranded-chile-peru-border-repatriated-venezuela-2023-05-07/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Arab League]] re-admits [[Syria]] as a member, after being suspended 12 years ago due to the [[Syrian civil war]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/05/07/Arab-foreign-ministers-to-discuss-Syria-s-return-to-Arab-League-Sudan-conflict (Al Arabiya)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Brownsville crash]]
**Eight people are killed and nine others are injured when a driver crashes into a group of pedestrians in [[Brownsville, Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.valleycentral.com/news/local-news/brownsville-police-investigating-major-accident/ (KVEO-TV)]
*[[Capital punishment in Iraq]]
**A court in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]], [[sentence (law)|sentences]] a former [[police officer]] to death for the murder of prominent academic [[Hisham al-Hashimi]] in July 2020, although the sentence can be appealed. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230507-iraq-court-sentences-to-death-killer-of-academic-hisham-al-hashemi (AFP via France 24)]

*[[2023 Turkish presidential election]]
